_readme: Reference / template pay-period calendar — no employee data of any kind.
This is the exact `payPeriods` array from AJSU-Tasker-v6.html (~line 723),
extracted so it can be modeled from without editing the shipped app file.
TO USE FOR YOUR OWN CALENDAR:
1. Replace the entries in `payPeriods` below with your own pay period
start/end/payDate values. `id` must be sequential starting at 1.
2. Paste the resulting array (drop this _readme block and the wrapping
object — just the array itself) back into AJSU-Tasker-v6.html in place
3. ROLLOVER TRAP: PAY_YEAR is computed in the app as
The '+1' is only correct if period 1's START date falls in DECEMBER of
the year BEFORE the pay year (as it does below: start 2025-12-21 for
pay year 2026). If your period 1 instead starts in January of its own
pay year, remove the '+1' and derive PAY_YEAR from payPeriods[0].end
instead — otherwise every storage key and row-id year suffix will be
silently off by one, orphaning data on the next calendar rollover.
4. Re-run the test suite (see testing.md) after swapping the calendar —
several assertions seed data against specific period boundaries.
